item.title: Is the Cliff Booth Trailer Supposed to Be That Dark?
item.description: On this week's “Screen Talk” podcast, we review the first look at David Fincher's film, dive deeper into "Wuthering Heights," and button up a still-buzzing Oscars luncheon.

item.title: ‘Everybody Digs Bill Evans’ Review: The Tragic Jazz Musician Gets a Biopic That Runs Counter to Convention
item.description: Berlin: Anders Danielsen Lie stars in Grant Gee's fact-based film, which traces the unavoidable costs imposed on a family for the fleeting brush with artistic transcendence.

item.title: ‘Lorne’ Documentary on Lorne Michaels Caps a Long Streak of Recent ‘SNL’ Films
item.description: Morgan Neville is directing the documentary from Focus Features that opens in theaters April 17.

item.title: ‘Neighbors’ Review: Josh Safdie’s Sad HBO Comedy Exacerbates the Problem It’s Documenting
item.description: Directors Harrison Fishman and Dylan Redford's documentary series studies heated conflicts between bizarre neighbors across America, but its gaping depictions of oblivious subjects tend to encourage an already secluded country toward further isolationism.

item.title: ‘Love Letters’ Trailer: ‘Raw’ Star Ella Rumpf Navigates New Motherhood in Queer Cannes Favorite
item.description: Alice Douard's directing debut premiered at Cannes Critics' Week last year and won the Grand Jury Prize for International Narrative Feature at NewFest.

item.title: ‘Yellow Letters’ Review: A Turkish Artist Couple Fractures but Never Falls Apart in ‘Teachers’ Lounge’ Director’s Politically Vexed Latest
item.description: Berlin: İlker Çatak's thought-provoking, politically rousing drama follows a pair of thespians pushed out of Ankara and into Istanbul because of state censorship.

item.title: Oscar Frontrunner Stellan Skarsgård Looks Back at His Best Roles, from ‘Breaking the Waves’ to ‘Dune’
item.description: He also digs into "Sentimental Value," nominated for nine Oscars. And he explains that these days, after a stroke between the "Dune" films, he's working from an earpiece that feeds him lines on set.

item.title: IndieWire Is Partnering with Lavazza to Take You Inside the 2026 Indie Spirit Awards
item.description: Content creator and filmmaker Reagan Yorke and IW's Christian Zilko will team on the blue carpet and inside the celebration of everything indie for insightful (and caffeinated) talent interviews.

item.title: Let the Shockingly Sweet ‘Friday the 13th – Part VI: Jason Lives’ Sweep You Off Your Feet This Valentine’s Day
item.description: Tom McLoughlin's 1986 slasher is the best in the series — and weirdly great for Valentine's Day.

item.title: Sundance 2026 Movies Sold So Far: Grand Jury Prize Winner ‘Josephine’ Sells to Newcomer Sumerian Pictures
item.description: Director Beth de Araújo's widely acclaimed film stars Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan and was picked up in a competitive, 7-figure deal.
